# Pinned HSI trial-screening engine

Unmodified browser-safe copies of `hsi-core/src/trialsCriteriaMvp.ts` and
`hsi-core/src/cdsPhiBoundary.ts`. Repository commit and SHA-256 values are in
`provenance.json`; `synthetic-programme.test.ts` checks source integrity.

Used only with fictional synthetic protocols and non-PHI cases in the research
programme. Product maturity remains Planned; no report grants eligibility.
Do not edit vendor files independently or expose this as a production registry
matcher. Update deliberately from the canonical HSI substrate and rerun tests.
